caption:
Google Deepmind's WeatherNext has made significant strides in cyclone forecasting, allowing for simultaneous predictions of cyclone tracks and intensity. This innovative model was developed in collaboration with the National Hurricane Center and has shown promising results during live forecasts since June 2025. 🌪️
